**LaküenPlay v1.0.1 – Handheld** names the build again: v1.0 on the new Lichii base showed Lichii's name only.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/LakuenPlay/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.0.1-Handheld-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled for Zen 2 and later with profile-guided optimization (a profile recorded on a Steam Deck) |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.0.1-Handheld-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

## What's new since v1.0

- **LaküenPlay's name** in the window title, the About dialog and the log ("LaküenPlay – Handheld", based on Lichii and Eden). Data folders and settings stay Lichii's, so nothing moves.

Everything else is as in [v1.0](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/LakuenPlay/releases/tag/handheld-v1.0): the current Lichii base (past build 160) with this fork's memory work for 16 GB handhelds.
